Added postcondition `ensures \result == \add_float(\add_float(\mul_float(v0.x, v1.x), \mul_float(v0.y, v1.y)), \mul_float(v0.z, v1.z));` which provides the exact value of the dot product computation. Added postcondition `ensures \result == \add_float(\add_float(\mul_float(v0.x, v1.x), \mul_float(v0.y, v1.y)), \mul_float(v0.z, v1.z));` which provides the exact floating-point value of the computation. This allows callers to reason about the result when v0 == v1.
